context: M12 o6. Fifth Ave & W 36th. Delphine knocks on the window of Calloway's parked sedan.

lines.speaker: char.delphine_moore
lines.text: You bought a man lunch. I'd like to know what's on his bill.

lines.speaker: char.ruth_calloway
lines.text: And you are the woman two stools down with a camera in her bag.

lines.speaker: char.delphine_moore
lines.text: Rule eight: if you see me, I've already seen you.

lines.speaker: char.ruth_calloway
lines.text: Brannock. Wurtz. The tax on Eighth. You've been taking pictures.

lines.speaker: char.delphine_moore
lines.text: Maybe. They're mine. Not evidence. Not yet.

lines.speaker: char.ruth_calloway
lines.text: Everybody in that district is a witness. Most just don't know it yet.
